claims.evidence_excerpt: Minutes or Notes on Script Conference Covering Work of CHSP(P) Clarence Moran, Field Photo Branch
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The official archival guide names Clarence Moran in the Field Photo Branch and uses a grade abbreviation aligning with the index's distinctive C SP-P entry.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence because exact name and the unusually specific grade or position abbreviation agree across the index and an official OSS archival guide.
claims.temporal_assessment: This establishes a wartime OSS assignment, not Clarence Moran's pre-OSS employer.
claims.match_notes: The five-page WN#08587 item should be reviewed with the Box 536 personnel file before reconstructing any predecessor affiliation.

claims.claim_text: Wayne E Moore's identity remains conflicting because the protected identifier printed in the index retrieves an official Army record under a different name.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The index and Army source agree on the private identifier but disagree completely on the person's name.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Conflicting. A protected identifier cannot establish Wayne E Moore's identity when the official Army record names a different person.
claims.temporal_assessment: Identity conflict only; no employment chronology is inferred.
claims.match_notes: The Army candidate is rejected as Wayne E Moore. The discrepancy may reflect an index transcription or column-association error and requires Box 536 review.
